name: values_creation_has_no_observable_reads
source: let log=[]; let p=new Proxy([10,20], {get(t,k,r){log.push(String(k));return Reflect.get(t,k,r);}}); let it=Array.prototype.values.call(p); let before=log.join(','); let a=it.next().value; let b=it.next().value; let done=it.next().done; [before,a,b,done,log.join(',')].join('|')

name: huge_proxy_only_reads_requested_prefix
source: let log=[]; let p=new Proxy({length:9007199254740991,0:7,1:8}, {get(t,k,r){log.push(String(k));return Reflect.get(t,k,r);}}); let it=Array.prototype.values.call(p); [log.length,it.next().value,it.next().value,log.join(',')].join('|')

name: keys_do_not_read_elements
source: let log=[]; let p=new Proxy({length:3}, {get(t,k,r){log.push(String(k));if(k!=='length')throw 'element';return 3;}}); let it=Array.prototype.keys.call(p); [it.next().value,it.next().value,it.next().value,it.next().done,log.join(',')].join('|')

name: done_is_permanent_after_shrink
source: let log=[];let a=[1,2,3];let it=Array.prototype.values.call(new Proxy(a,{get(t,k,r){log.push(String(k));return Reflect.get(t,k,r);}}));let x=it.next().value;a.length=0;let done=it.next().done;a.push(9,10,11);[x,done,it.next().done,log.join(',')].join('|')

name: length_throw_does_not_advance
source: let log=[];let fail=true;let p=new Proxy({length:1,0:9},{get(t,k,r){log.push(String(k));if(k==='length'&&fail){fail=false;throw 'length';}return Reflect.get(t,k,r);}});let it=Array.prototype.values.call(p);let error='';try{it.next();}catch(e){error=e;}[error,it.next().value,it.next().done,log.join(',')].join('|')

name: partial_consumption_does_not_touch_suffix
source: let log=[];let p=new Proxy({length:1000000000,0:7},{get(t,k,r){log.push(String(k));if(k==='1')throw 'suffix';return Reflect.get(t,k,r);}});let it=Array.prototype.values.call(p);let first;for(let x of it){first=x;break;}[first,log.join(',')].join('|')

name: independent_iterators_share_live_source
source: let a=[1,2];let p=new Proxy(a,{});let x=Array.prototype.values.call(p);let y=Array.prototype.values.call(p);let first=x.next().value;a[0]=9;a[1]=8;[first,y.next().value,x.next().value,y.next().value].join('|')

name: nullish_receivers_still_throw
source: let out=[];for(let x of [null,undefined])for(let k of ['keys','values','entries'])try{Array.prototype[k].call(x);}catch(e){out.push(e.name);}out.join('|')
